title: Federated Differentially Private Optimization via Low-Rank Preconditioning
abstract: arXiv:2610.31069v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We consider differentially private (DP) optimization in the federated setting, where a DP estimate of the feature covariance matrix serves as a Hessian approximation for generalized linear models. Existing central DP methods for covariance estimation have communication cost that grows quadratically in the data dimension, while existing baselines with linear communication cost are only locally private and degrade as the number of clients increases. As a remedy, we propose a federated DP-PCA framework that achieves linear communication cost while providing central DP guarantees under secure aggregation. It consists of a DP rank selection step, a DP power method, and a noisy release of the covariance projected onto the selected low-dimensional subspace. translated_title: 基于低秩预条件化的联邦差分隐私优化
translated_abstract: 我们研究联邦场景下的差分隐私（DP）优化问题，其中特征协方差矩阵的差分隐私估计被用作广义线性模型的Hessian近似。现有的中心化差分隐私协方差估计方法的通信成本随数据维度呈二次方增长，而具有线性通信成本的现有基线方法仅能提供本地隐私保护，且随着客户端数量的增加性能会下降。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个联邦DP-PCA框架，在安全聚合下以线性通信成本提供中心化差分隐私保证。该框架由差分隐私秩选择步骤、差分隐私幂迭代法以及投影到所选低维子空间上的协方差的噪声化释放组成。我们给出了该协方差估计的误差界，以及基于该估计的低通信预条件化差分隐私梯度下降方法的误差界。实验结果表明，我们提出的差分隐私优化方法与中心化方法性能相当（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一种联邦DP-PCA框架，通过低秩预条件化以线性通信成本实现中心化差分隐私保证，从而高效解决联邦差分隐私优化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a federated DP-PCA framework that achieves central differential privacy guarantees with linear communication cost through low-rank preconditioning, enabling efficient federated differentially private optimization.
